keySentence: Jim survived by using his mind.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Silver tried to catch Jim. Jim talked calmly to Silver. Words can be powerful tools. Jim survived by using his mind.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: When Silver tried to capture Jim, the boy stayed perfectly calm. Instead of fighting or crying, Jim used his words carefully. He figured out what Silver wanted and offered a clever deal. Surprisingly, Silver listened to Jim's proposal. Jim survived by using his mind. Jim proved that talking is sometimes better than fighting.
facts.Page story text 3 (draft, teacher check: In a tense moment, Silver cornered Jim and tried to take him hostage. Most children would have panicked, but Jim remained remarkably calm and composed. He analyzed Silver's desires and motivations with surprising maturity. Then Jim proposed a deal that appealed to Silver's self-interest. Jim survived by using his mind. However, the real genius was that Jim's deal also protected his friends from harm. Because Jim understood that communication can be more powerful than confrontation, he saved lives. Silver was so impressed by the boy's intelligence that he began to respect Jim in a new way.
